requirements.quote: A lane cannot merge a CI addition unless it states what it costs and when it triggers, and prefers extending an existing shared job over adding a workflow or job.
New `forge.yaml` keys under `ci.budget`: `max_workflows`, `max_ci_jobs`, `monthly_minutes`, and `shared_regression_job` (the job or dir new one-file checks must join).

Lane check: when a lane diff adds a workflow file, adds a job to a workflow, or adds a CI step that runs a single test file, the lane must either fold it into `shared_regression_job` or carry a `FORGE:CI_BUDGET` annotation.
The annotation gives the trigger scope, estimated minutes per month, and why a shared job can't hold it.
A missing annotation fails the lane check, the same way other conformance failures do.
Infra review agent: flags any new workflow or job without concurrency, `timeout-minutes`, path scoping, or (for issue/comment events) a job-level `if:` filter.
Exceeding `max_workflows`/`max_ci_jobs` fails the lane check unless the same PR removes or folds an equal amount.
Release-bundle review reports net CI change in the bundle: workflows, jobs and estimated minutes.
Fixture tests cover the lane check: a lane adding a bare workflow fails, a lane folding into the shared job passes, and an annotated workflow passes.

deliverables.change: New pure module (no LLM, no new dependency; SPDX header like bin/lean/docsgate.mjs). Exports: (a) parseCiBudget(ciSection) -> {maxWorkflows, maxCiJobs, monthlyMinutes, sharedJob} from the FLAT forge.yaml `ci` section (parseForgeYaml flattens `ci.budget.*` into `ci`; posInt or null; sharedJob string or null). (b) scanWorkflow(text) -> {triggers:{name:{paths:boolean}}, concurrency:boolean, jobs:[{id, start, end, timeout:boolean, concurrency:boolean, if:boolean}], annotations:[{line, trigger, minutes, why}]}: an indentation-based scanner of `on:` (scalar, list, or map form), top-level `concurrency:`, and the `jobs:` children (job id lines at the first indent under jobs; range = up to the next job id); `timeout-minutes:`, `concurrency:`, `if:` at the job's direct-child indent. (c) parseAnnotation(line): `# FORGE:CI_BUDGET trigger=<scope> minutes=<N> why=<text>` (why runs to end of line); invalid when any of trigger, minutes (non-negative number, optional `/month` suffix) or why is missing/empty. (d) singleTestFileSteps(addedLines): an added `run:` line (or a line of a `run: |` block) invoking a test runner (node --test, vitest, jest, pytest, go test, npx playwright test, mocha, bash *.test.sh) with exactly one test-file argument (*.test.*, *.spec.*, *_test.*, test_*.py, *.test.sh). (e) ciGateFindings({cfg, base:{path:text}, head:{path:text}}) -> failures, each {code:'conformance.unimplemented', kind, detail} with kinds: `ci_budget_unannotated` (an added workflow file, an added job id in an existing workflow, or an added single-test-file step, none of which has a valid annotation in its scope and none of which is folded: a job/step is folded when its job id equals cfg.sharedJob, or the step's test file is under cfg.sharedJob when that value contains '/'; annotation scope: anywhere in an added file covers the file and all its jobs; for an added job, the job's line range plus the contiguous comment lines directly above its id line; for a step, its job's scope), `ci_budget_annotation_invalid` (an annotation in scope that misses trigger, minutes or why: the detail names the missing field), `ci_budget_exceeded` (cfg.maxWorkflows set and head workflow count > max and > base count; same for cfg.maxCiJobs with total job count over all workflows), `ci_hygiene` (for each added workflow and each added job: no concurrency at workflow or job level; no job-level timeout-minutes; a push/pull_request/pull_request_target trigger without paths or paths-ignore; an issues/issue_comment/pull_request_review_comment/discussion_comment trigger with a job lacking a job-level if:). Workflow files = `.github/workflows/*.yml|*.yaml`. Details name the file and job id and say how to fix (fold into the shared job, or annotate with all three fields). (f) async ciBudgetFailures({cfg, base, git}) reading `git diff --name-only <base>...HEAD -- .github/workflows`, returning [] without further git calls when no workflow file changed; otherwise `git ls-tree -r --name-only <base|HEAD> -- .github/workflows` and `git show <ref>:<path>` for both sides, then ciGateFindings. (g) netCiChange({base, head, cfg}) -> {workflows:Δ, jobs:Δ, minutes: sum of annotated minutes added minus removed, line:'CI_NET: workflows ±N, jobs ±M, est. minutes/month ±K[ of <monthlyMinutes> budget]'}. (h) CLI when run directly: `node bin/lean/ci-gate.mjs net --base REF --head REF [--cwd DIR]` prints the CI_NET line (reads forge.yaml ci section from --cwd for monthly_minutes); exit 0, prints `CI_NET: unknown (<why>)` on any read failure.

node:test fixtures with in-memory base/head maps: bare added workflow fails ci_budget_unannotated and ci_hygiene; step added to the shared_regression_job job passes; single-file test step added to another job fails unless annotated; annotated workflow with concurrency, timeout-minutes and paths passes; annotation missing minutes fails ci_budget_annotation_invalid; job added to an existing workflow needs an annotation above or inside it; max_workflows exceeded fails and passes when the same diff deletes a workflow; max_ci_jobs folded (job removed + job added) passes; issue_comment job without if: fails ci_hygiene; schedule-only workflow needs no paths; parseCiBudget on parseForgeYaml output of a nested ci.budget block; ciBudgetFailures with a fake git returns [] and makes one git call when no workflow changed; netCiChange line for +1 workflow +2 jobs; CLI prints CI_NET unknown on a bad ref.
precheck() takes an optional `ciBudgetFailures = null` param and appends its entries to failures (one line next to docsFailures, comment #5760). Nothing else changes.
One case: precheck with ciBudgetFailures [{code:'conformance.unimplemented', kind:'ci_budget_unannotated', detail:'x'}] returns ok:false with that failure; existing cases unchanged.

runCore option `ciBudget = null` (destructure at ~:302). In the precheck block (~:3206-3237) compute `const ciBudgetFail = await ciBudgetFailures({ cfg: ciBudget ?? parseCiBudget(null), base, git })` (always on: the annotation and hygiene checks need no config; max_* checks only when set), catching errors to [] with an event, and pass `ciBudgetFailures: ciBudgetFail` to precheck.
readEnvConfig (~:582-602) adds `ciBudget: parseCiBudget(y?.ci)` to its returned object when any ci.budget key is set.

One readEnvConfig case: a forge.yaml with `ci:
  budget:
    max_workflows: 12
    shared_regression_job: regression` yields ciBudget {maxWorkflows:12, sharedJob:'regression', ...}; absent block yields no ciBudget key.

CLOSED gains "ci.budget": ["max_workflows","max_ci_jobs","monthly_minutes","shared_regression_job"]; TYPES gains the three numbers and shared_regression_job scalar. Comment: flattened under ci, monthly_minutes is the same key as #5278's ci.monthly_minutes.
Case: ci.budget with the four keys validates clean; an unknown ci.budget key and a non-number max_workflows are reported.

forge.yaml `ci.budget` rows (four keys, defaults: unset = no max) plus the FORGE:CI_BUDGET annotation format, the four failure kinds, and the note that ci.budget.monthly_minutes and ci.monthly_minutes are one key (flat ci section). Distinguish it from the .forge/release.yaml ci.budget (on_exceed) block.

One numbered check (within the spec-size budget): for a new workflow or job, missing concurrency, timeout-minutes, path scoping (push/pull_request) or a job-level if: (issue/comment events) is a BLOCKING finding (the engine's ci_hygiene precheck detects these; cite them); also judge whether the addition could join the configured shared_regression_job and flag a FORGE:CI_BUDGET why that does not hold up.

One builder rule line in the implement instructions: prefer adding a check to forge.yaml ci.budget.shared_regression_job over a new workflow/job/step; otherwise annotate with `# FORGE:CI_BUDGET trigger=... minutes=... why=...` and give new workflows/jobs concurrency, timeout-minutes, paths and event if: filters.

`scope` subcommand: after the fetch, run `node "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../bin/lean/ci-gate.mjs" net --base origin/$DEFAULT_BRANCH --head origin/$STAGING_BRANCH` fail-soft (CI_NET: unknown on error), print its CI_NET line and write it as `ci_net` into <N>_scope.json. Outside every BEGIN/END block; Bash 3.2 portable.
Assert the scope subcommand output contains a CI_NET line and scope.json has ci_net.
In the manifest line list (~:132) and the final summary items (~:432), add `CI_NET:` (net workflows, jobs, est. minutes) to report in the bundle review summary; a few words only (spec-size budget).

decisions.choice: The lane check is a deterministic module feeding precheck (like docsgate), not a new agent or prompt-only rule; the infra prompt gets one judgment line.
decisions.justification: NORTHSTAR.md 'Where a fix belongs' layer 3 and non-negotiable 2; precedent bin/lean/docsgate.mjs:76 docsFailures wired at bin/lean/lean.mjs:3208/3237.

decisions.choice: ci.budget.monthly_minutes is the same key as #5278's ci.monthly_minutes; all ci.budget key names stay unique within ci.
decisions.justification: bin/forge-utils.mjs:66 parseForgeYaml flattens nested blocks (verified: ci.budget.monthly_minutes overwrites ci.monthly_minutes); bin/config-schema.mjs:24 states the same uniqueness rule for ci.tests.

decisions.choice: FORGE:CI_BUDGET is a YAML comment in the workflow diff (file scope or job scope), not a PR-body marker.
decisions.justification: The lane check runs before the PR exists (bin/lean/lean.mjs:3237 precheck); a comment lives in the diff GitHub keeps, per NORTHSTAR non-negotiable 3.

decisions.choice: Annotation and hygiene checks are on by default (no config needed); max_workflows/max_ci_jobs apply only when set; no new on/off flag.
decisions.justification: Issue Expected Behavior applies to every lane; the gate only fires when a lane adds CI, so it cannot 'always fire' (NORTHSTAR non-negotiable 4); blocking follows the repo's existing conformance mode like other kinds (bin/lean/lean.mjs:302 conformance).

decisions.choice: Workflow YAML is scanned by indentation with no YAML dependency.
decisions.justification: The repo parses forge.yaml the same way (bin/forge-utils.mjs:66) and adds no YAML library; the facts needed (on/jobs/timeout/concurrency/if/paths keys) are key-presence checks.

decisions.choice: The release-bundle net CI line is produced by review-staging-pre.sh scope via the ci-gate CLI and listed in the review summary spec.
decisions.justification: scripts/review-staging-pre.sh:15 scope already writes the bundle scope facts the staging review reports (commands/review-pr-staging.md:132,432).
